items.text: Every active ledger task is done; every excluded task is explicitly owner-deferred; no live leases; merge queue empty (no queued or retest rows)
v4 trace check passes: every requirement covered, every done task has an evidence receipt
R1 held: module contract cards updated for every touched module
R2 held: every behavior change has an owner-approved spec revision
High-risk tasks show blind-test + independent-review receipts; ordinary tasks show integration review at checkpoints
One commit per task; no commit mixes tasks; clean baseline before every worktree

redFlags: 'All tests pass' without a test-run receipt
Tests that passed on their first run (they may not test what you think)
A worktree that edited files outside its task's declared scope

rationalizations.excuse: The docs can catch up after the merge
rationalizations.reality: R1 exists so a fresh session reads docs instead of the whole codebase. Stale cards poison every later session.
